g.text: y = Xβ + ε puts every regression in one form. Solve the normal equations XᵀX β̂ = Xᵀy (software uses a stable solver).

g.text: Dividing SSE and TSS by the same n keeps R²; dividing by their degrees of freedom gives adjusted R².
